title: Chapter 39: Counter-Encirclement And Suppression (Part 3)
content:
Chapter 39: Counter-Encirclement And Suppression (Part 3)

400 Hydralisks completely suppressed the Lizardmen army into the woods.

The Lizardmen army entered the forest. Although the trees blocked some of the Hydralisks' long-range attacks, they also broke up their own formation.

The Lizardmen soldiers, who were relatively weak in individual strength, lost the protection of the army formation and faced the attacks of the puppies in the forest without any resistance.

At the right time, Wu Qing gave an order, and nearly 5,000 puppies rushed into the forest like a black torrent, devouring all life.

But in a moment, the forest fell into silence.

The Zerg killed 6/10 one-star creatures.

The Zerg used three battles to eliminate nearly 10,000 Lizardmen, and the strength of the entire Zerg became stronger and stronger.

The puppies came out of the forest and joined the Hydralisks, and began to calmly meet the reinforcements of the Bugbears.

Facing such a large-scale enemy, it was no longer necessary to fight an ambush. In order to kill more enemies, it was not worthwhile to expose the Zerg's latent ability.

It is a bit difficult to completely wipe out the army of the bear goblins who came to support today. This depends on the opportunity and cannot be forced.

Wu Qing made a concession and tried to take advantage of the enemy as much as possible.

Soon, the two armies met and the formation was deployed. Looking around, the bear goblins had an absolute advantage.

But more soldiers do not necessarily mean victory. It depends on how the battle is fought.

Wu Qing's idea is very simple. The Zerg will deploy the formation and use the Hydralisks to attack remotely to test the enemy's response, and then decide on the next tactics.

The Zerg's command can be very flexible, and various tactics are only between his thoughts.

This time, the commander of the bear goblin army is another bear goblin priest. Because of the existence of this priest, Wu Qing has no confidence in completely wiping out this army.

The bear goblin priest looked at the Zerg army that he had never seen before, and knew that the three lizardmen armies sent to lure the enemy should be in danger.

Although he knew that the Lizardmen's army was not strong, the fact that they could destroy nearly 10,000 Lizardmen in such a short time showed some clues of the powerful combat power of this mysterious race.

Facing such an enemy, he was alert, but not afraid.

At this time, the Hydralisks lined up in front of the Zerg army had already launched an attack on the Lizardmen's army without hesitation. The powerful jet attack, even at a long distance, also caused a lot of casualties to the Lizardmen's army.

"It turned out to be a believer of the alien god!"

Looking at the corpses of the Lizardmen that kept turning into light and disappearing, the bear goblin priest understood that only the believers of the gods had the ability to sacrifice on the battlefield.

The system's material-energy conversion would be regarded as a sacrifice to the gods in this world, and sacrifice is a very common ability.

Wu Qing didn't need to disguise himself when using it. The various abilities of the system appeared in this world and were rationalized and would not cause him any trouble.

The bear goblin priest looked at the puppy who was ready for battle, and did not rashly send troops to attack, but also ordered a long-range attack.

"Throw stones!"

Both the bugbears and the lizardmen were experts in throwing stones. When the order was given, all kinds of stones were thrown at the Zerg army like rain.

The sound of stones hitting the Zerg's shells was endless.

The stones thrown by the lizardmen were okay, and basically did not cause any damage to the Zerg. The stones thrown by the bugbear soldiers were more lethal.

But they only injured some of the puppies. It was still very difficult to kill the Zerg, because the Zerg's shells were very capable of defending against such attacks.

Under the violent storm of stone attacks, the Zerg army remained motionless and waited patiently.

The hydralisks continued to attack, constantly harvesting the lives of the lizardmen.

The bugbear priest saw that his long-range attack was not effective, so he ordered the entire army to advance slowly and keep the formation to press towards the Zerg.

"All troops advance! Keep the formation!"

The bugbear knight who delivered the order shouted loudly.

Faced with the pressure of the army of the Bugbears, the Zerg army remained unmoved.

The Hydralisks continued to attack, and each of their spikes was accumulating strength for the development of the Zerg.

The distance between the two armies gradually shortened to dozens of meters, and they could engage in close combat with just one charge.

When the Bugbear priest was considering whether to order a charge, the Zerg's puppies suddenly moved.

2,000 puppies rushed out from the left and right sides of the Zerg army, rushing towards the lizardmen on both wings of the Bugbear army.

Only about 1,000 puppies were left in the main formation to guard the Hydralisks and began to retreat. The kite-flying tactics of the Zerg Hydralisks were finally used here.

2,000 puppies on each side rushed into the Lizardmen army, like cavalry rushing into the light infantry battle formation, easily crushing a bloody path.

The puppies did not want to fight, and rushed past, leaving a large piece of the Lizardmen's army on both wings missing.

Some of the puppies that were trapped in the Lizardmen's army and could not escape fought frantically, fighting for their lives to gain the greatest benefits for the Zerg.

The bear goblin priest saw the Zerg's puppies' melee ability and quickly ordered the Lizardmen on both wings to shrink their formation and strengthen their defense.

The hydralisks in front of the formation kept staring at the Lizardmen, and the puppies on both wings were eyeing the Lizardmen, launching attacks from time to time, tearing off a corner from the tightly defended army.

This caused serious casualties among the Lizardmen.

The bear goblin priest also saw that the Lizardmen were completely restrained in the battle with the Zerg, and were simply giving away their heads.

He took out the mysterious faith object, silently prayed, and a divine light flashed, and he blessed the bear goblin soldiers in front of the battle.

The nearly 2,000 bear goblin soldiers who received the blessing changed their momentum, and a fighting spirit rose to the sky.

Judging from the proficiency of this priest in controlling the energy of faith and the effect of blessing on the combat soldiers, he is much stronger than the last bear goblin priest Wu Qing met.

These priests are related to the gods, can use the power of faith, and have all kinds of abilities. For Wu Qing, the threat of a priest is greater than that of an army.

The blessed bear goblin soldiers launched a fierce charge at the hydralisks in front.

The fanatical bear goblin soldiers are tall and strong, with strong physiques, leather armor, and have received powerful blessings from the priests. Their defense against the long-range attacks of the hydralisks has greatly increased.

The thorns of the hydralisk hit them, and as long as they do not directly penetrate the vital parts of the body, the impact on their combat power is very limited.

Their charge was very fast, and they rushed out of the formation and quickly approached the phalanx of the Hydralisk.

Facing such an enemy, the Hydralisk's long-range attack was greatly reduced.

The Hydralisk continued to shoot, trying to cause the greatest damage to the bugbear soldiers. If they turned around and ran, they would be chased all the time.

In this state, the bugbear soldiers were not much slower than the Hydralisk, and the Hydralisk might have to run away.

The Hydralisk's persistence made the charging bugbear soldiers pay a certain price. When the bugbear soldiers rushed to the front, 1,000 puppies around the Hydralisk rushed out.
